title: NFL's 6 biggest unanswered offseason questions, including do Chiefs and Patrick Mahomes have enough weapons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL's 6 biggest unanswered offseason questions, including do Chiefs and Patrick Mahomes have enough weapons
sources.description: Many teams are relying on internal growth, health and coaching adjustments to offset lingering holes as they prepare for training camp and the season ahead. The AFC, in particular, looks especially wide open due to these uncertainties.
